statement: The pinned xpadneo source maps an Xbox logo HID usage to BTN_XBOX and the designated Share usage to BTN_SHARE, discovers the battery report ID from the HID descriptor and translates battery flags to Linux power-supply properties. Its documentation separately describes Share as an F12 shortcut, so code and narrative should not be assumed equivalent without a versioned consumer test.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: mappings.c:32-66, 130-155; events.c:65-85; power.c:12-167; docs/README.md:150-156. No xpad-like exact 26-control guarantee.
